svg.title: What TinyDoc returns for every field
svg.desc: A receipt with three annotated values is linked to a result table showing field name, value, exact evidence quote, and confidence. Low confidence routes the field to review.

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, serif
Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Schema: 1.00 valid on clean-100 · evidence coverage: 0.80 of non-empty fields · overlay PNG available

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Confidence is for review routing, not a probability

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Field ECE 0.115–0.135 raw and 0.005–0.014 after document-grouped isotonic out-of-fold. Document-level confidence is not calibrated (ECE 0.09–0.10).

svg.text: Grounding is OCR-span evidence, not model-predicted boxes: VLM box hit@0.5 is 0.04–0.20 against a 0.70 gate.
